title: Counting disjoint V-translates of the unit ball inside B_{ρ+1}(0)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P and V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace such that ν({x : v + x ∈ A}) = ν(A) for every v ∈ V and every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P. Let S ⊆ ℝ^P be a finite set and ρ ∈ ℝ such that every x ∈ S lies in V and satisfies ‖x‖ ≤ ρ, and dist(x, y) ≥ 2 for all distinct x, y ∈ S. Then (#S)·ν(B_1(0)) ≤ ν(B_{ρ+1}(0)) in [0, ∞] (open balls).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (S : Finset (Euclid P)) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ V) → (∀ x ∈ S, ‖x‖ ≤ ρ) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, x ≠ y → 2 ≤ dist x y) → (S.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ν (ball 0 1) ≤ ν (ball 0 (ρ + 1))
